Preparation Time 15 minutesCooking Time 45 – 50 minutes (or less if one big one done!)

8
oz pure gram flour
1
tablespoon rice flour
1
tablespoon sesame seeds
1
tablespoon jeera powder
¼
teaspoon chilli powder
1
teaspoon turmeric
1
teaspoon salt
2
large onions, finely sliced
1
tablespoon dried coriander
7
fluid ounces water
Oil
for deep frying

Method:-
Sieve the gram flour into bowl
Add all dry ingredients and mix
Gradually add water until a thick paste is made
Heat the oil to a depth of 3 inches in a wok over a medium heat
Either drop heaped tablespoons of the mixture into the oil (not too large or the centre will not cook) and fry for 5-6 minutes until golden brown
Or put large amount of mixture in and flatten to make centre thin enough to cook
